title: Generative AI Fundamentals: Understanding ChatGPT
description: Hands-on exploration of how ChatGPT and modern LLMs process language. Members broke down tokenization, vector embeddings, transformer attention mechanisms, and next-word probability distributions.

title: Hands-on GenAI with Google AI Studio
description: Practical engineering session utilizing Google AI Studio and Gemini models. Members sharpened multi-turn prompt engineering techniques, system instructions, and collaborated in squads to prototype solutions.

title: Speak Beyond Words: JAM Session
description: High-energy Just A Minute (JAM) public speaking workshop aimed at conquering stage fright, sharpening extempore clarity, structuring quick arguments, and boosting executive presence.

title: Money Matters: Education to Financial Freedom
description: Demystifying personal finance for college students: budget allocation, index funds, equity market basics, inflation hedging, and the exponential power of compounding for early financial autonomy.

title: Spy Among Us: Social Deduction & Strategy
description: Strategic deception and deduction workshop where teams identified concealed players through structured inquiry, body language analysis, and consensus building.
